text:
Evan L: hi all, first day! I'm setting up the MBP M2 and the MDM says my device is enrolled but FileVault never prompted for a recovery key and when I try to run a software update it asks for admin credentials. I don't have admin. Anyone seen this flow?
Marisol (IT): welcome Evan! we default to non-admin for new hires. FileVault should be escrowed via SCEP/profile and the recovery key stored in our MDM. Did you see any "Create Recovery Key" prompt during setup?
Evan L: nope, skipped through Welcome assistant fast and now Finder shows a lock icon on "Macintosh HD" in Finder > Info. I ran fdesetup status and it returned "FileVault is Off".
IT Helpdesk: opened ticket #INC-81234 and assigned to Marisol. Please don't attempt PRAM or firmware changes until we confirm.
mdm-bot: Device serial XXXXXX matched to Evan L. Last check-in 2m ago. Pending profiles: com.redwood.device.base (installed), com.redwood.security.fde (not installed). Scheduling targeted profile push.
Marisol (IT): looks like the FDE profile didn't finish. Can you run \nprofiles -P\nand paste output? Also check System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault for any prompts.
Evan L: profiles -P shows com.redwood.device.base Installed and com.redwood.security.fde Pending - User Approval Required. System Settings shows no FileVault prompt.
Marisol (IT): okay that's the race. On Ventura+/Apple silicon the FDE profile needs a user approval click. You should see a notification to allow the profile; it's safe. I'm going to push the approval token now so it installs without admin interaction. Hold for mdm-bot update.
Aaron (Security): quick note — security policy: do not grant full admin unless absolutely necessary. We prefer to approve the FDE profile via MDM so the escrowed key goes to our keyserver. If you see any prompt asking for a long recovery key to be typed, do NOT type it.
Evan L: got a desktop notification asking to "Install FDE profile". It shows issuer Redwood Security and requests permission to add a system profile.
Evan L: clicked Install -> It asked for my mac password to approve installation. I entered my user password and it succeeded.
mdm-bot: Push status: com.redwood.security.fde Delivered -> Installing -> Installed. Recovery key escrowed.
Marisol (IT): can you re-run fdesetup status and also try Software Update again?
Evan L: fdesetup status -> FileVault is On. Software Update now proceeds and doesn't prompt for admin during the update download, only for install which is expected.
Jade (Hiring): welcome Evan! ping me if you need access to onboarding docs or Slack invites.
IT Helpdesk: closing ticket #INC-81234. If any other device prompts appear, reopen and tag @Marisol (IT). :white_check_mark:
